title: Resume, end and custody
description: Relay cleanup rechecks an ungrouped record with the same process-identity observer used by its dead-session report. A missing or reused identity permits cleanup; an observation error retains the record. Process-group records retain custody while a member survives or group ownership remains unresolved. A group led by a new incarnation of its recorded leader pid was reused and reads gone. A resume record whose containment proved the exit never holds a wake as a running turn.
evidence: Source tests cover the original cleanup consumer, injected absent/reused/live/unavailable identities, live/unresolved/gone groups, reused group leaders, and contained exits with pruned captures. This is source proof, not released live proof.
